A1.justification: Both PDFs are readable, complete 36-page versions of the same survey, with corresponding sections, equations, figures, and tables. Both end with references; neither contains an appendix.

before.justification: v5 surveys existing research. Tables 1–2 compile prior methods and benchmark characteristics, and empirical findings are attributed to cited studies. No original empirical results are reported.

after.justification: v6 remains a literature survey. Its tables describe prior research, and its empirical observations are attributed to other studies; the added citations introduce no original empirical results.

M1.justification: Section 4 retains the same descriptions of tuning and prompting techniques. No algorithm, model component, training objective, or inference procedure is added or revised.

E1.justification: Section 5's application coverage and Table 2's benchmark inventory are unchanged. The added citation in Section 5.1.2 does not represent a new dataset or evaluation conducted by this work.

E2.justification: Neither version conducts an original baseline comparison, and Table 1 retains the same surveyed methods. The added citations are not newly evaluated comparators.

E3.justification: The reported data scales, training descriptions, and base models in Table 1 and benchmark scales and metrics in Table 2 match. No evaluation protocol or experimental setting is added or revised.

E4.justification: Section 7 gains citations without adding ablations, robustness tests, error analyses, or case studies. Existing descriptions of analyses attributed to prior work remain unchanged.

E5.justification: No run-count, seed, uncertainty-estimation, or significance-testing information is added or revised. Existing descriptions of statistical evaluation measures are unchanged.

E6.justification: All numerical entries in Tables 1–2 and the narrative's qualitative findings match. The additional citations introduce no reported result entries or changed findings.

T1.justification: Equation 1 and Section 2's input/output definitions are unchanged. No mathematical assumptions, propositions, proofs, or derivations are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same contributions: an input/output characterization, an attribute-methodology-application taxonomy, a benchmark compilation, and research challenges and directions.

C2.justification: Sections 7.1–7.4 retain the same explanations, limitations, and future directions. Citations added to the vulnerability and self-judging passages do not introduce new mechanisms, qualifications, or applicability boundaries.

D1.justification: The surveyed technical details and first-page website and paper-list access information remain unchanged. No implementation instructions, hyperparameters, hardware information, or code/data resources are added or revised.

R1.justification: v6 adds citations and bibliography entries for E2CL in Section 5.1.2; Fairer Preferences, Aligning with Logic, and Aligning with Human Judgement in Section 7.1; and Preference Leakage in Section 7.3. This is a limited literature expansion without revised research positioning. Other changed author-year suffixes identify retained works.

P1.justification: Edits are limited to citation insertions, author-year disambiguation, and the arXiv version/date stamp. The explanatory prose, terminology, section order, and narrative organization remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Added citations and bibliography entries cause local line wrapping and column/page-break changes, particularly in Sections 7.1–7.3 and the references. Figures 1–5 and Tables 1–2 retain their designs, captions, structures, and placement apart from citation-label updates.

improvement.justification: v6 modestly broadens the reading list through citations attached to existing passages, without expanding their explanation or synthesis. The taxonomy, benchmark information, limitations, and conclusions remain unchanged, and visual differences are routine reflow. Overall survey quality is effectively unchanged.
